description: Release checks: reviewer agents stay read-only, and builders pass QA after their last edit before they stop. Each command runs hooks/run.sh in sh or Git Bash; on Windows without Git Bash, PowerShell skips the first line and runs the second.

hooks.command:
exec sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run.sh" session_status
$t = @(); if ($env:RELEASE_CHECKS_PYTHON) { $t += ,@($env:RELEASE_CHECKS_PYTHON) }; $t += ,@('py', '-3'); $t += ,@('python'); $t += ,@('python3'); foreach ($p in $t) { $e = $p[0]; $a = @($p | Select-Object -Skip 1); if (Get-Command $e -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { & $e @a "$env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/run.py" session_status; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { exit 0 } } }; $s = ''; try { $s = (@($input) -join '' | ConvertFrom-Json).session_id -replace '[^A-Za-z0-9_-]', '' } catch { }; $d = $env:TEMP; if (-not $d) { $d = '/tmp' }; $m = Join-Path $d "release-checks-no-python-$s"; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $m)) { New-Item -ItemType File -Path $m -Force | Out-Null; '{"systemMessage": "release-checks is off: it needs Python 3.9 or later, and none ran (tried py -3, python and python3). Install Python, or set RELEASE_CHECKS_PYTHON to its path."}' }; exit 0

Install Python, or set RELEASE_CHECKS_PYTHON to its path."}' }; exit 0
